message.content: {"note_claim":"The before-and-after image allegedly showing Nepal flood damage is AI-generated and does not depict the floods.","label":"SUPPORTS","quote":"नेपाल में बाढ़ से मची तबाही के दावे से वायरल तस्वीर फेक है। इस फोटो को एआई टूल्स की मदद से बनाया गया है।","reason":"The page directly concludes that the viral image presented as Nepal flood devastation is fake and was made using AI tools."}

parsed.note_claim: The before-and-after image allegedly showing Nepal flood damage is AI-generated and does not depict the floods.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: नेपाल में बाढ़ से मची तबाही के दावे से वायरल तस्वीर फेक है। इस फोटो को एआई टूल्स की मदद से बनाया गया है।
parsed.reason: The page directly concludes that the viral image presented as Nepal flood devastation is fake and was made using AI tools.
